name: MapViewer3D
description: Live 3D map of Hagga Basin and Deep Desert with players, bases (as 3D buildings), vehicles, caves, hazards and resources, inside the console. Nothing to install or enter: it reads the game database through the addon bridge (permission database:read, read only) and carries its terrain in the page, so it works in the console's sandbox without network access. Optional share links for players without a console account come from the MapViewer3D share gateway.
author: LaFamilia-Gaming.eu
